remarks: Welcome to Sandy Beach Living! Discover the charm of this move-in-ready ranch nestled on a desirable corner lot offering a surprisingly private, serene setting just minutes from the Niagara River! Wonderful curb appeal, a covered front porch and maintenance-free exterior welcome you home. The spacious eat-in kitchen features abundant cabinetry, luxury vinyl flooring, recessed lighting, pantry, and included appliances. The inviting living/dining area showcases a stunning three-sided wood-burning fireplace, wall of windows and sliding doors to the yard. Additional highlights include multi-zone heating, first-floor laundry with washer, dryer and utility sink, pull-down attic storage and a heated, insulated 12' x 19' attached garage. Double-wide driveway, additional concrete parking/patio area ideal for a boat, trailer, motor home, plus an electrified storage shed on a concrete pad. Freshly painted throughout! Updates include glass block windows, kitchen/dining windows (2025), blacktop driveway, exterior drain tile and concrete parking/patio area (2024). Enjoy optional beach and boating privileges through Sandy Beach Park Club membership. Convenient to Huth Road School, playgrounds, marina, restaurants and the Niagara River. Experience the charm, tranquility and lifestyle that make Sandy Beach so special.  Offers due 10/23/26 by 1 p.m.
